projetos.desafio: Bringing students, teachers and researchers together in a space for academic collaboration.
projetos.descricao:
Academic social network developed at my TCC to bring students, teachers and researchers together. The platform brings together articles, events, subject discussions, research projects and academic opportunities.

The proposal is to facilitate collaboration within the university, with a feed that prioritizes content according to the interests of each user.

projetos.tecnologias: React and Node.js in the first version; PHP and Laravel in a later stage
projetos.desafio: Give visibility to research and innovation initiatives and bring them closer to society.
projetos.descricao:
Platform for disseminating research, innovation and entrepreneurship initiatives supported by the Cearense Foundation to Support Scientific and Technological Development.

The showcase presents projects developed in Ceará, their solutions and application possibilities. The objective is to make scientific production more accessible and bring researchers, companies, investors and society closer together.

projetos.desafio: Combine strategy, spatial reasoning and interaction between players.
projetos.descricao:
A competitive version of Tetris for two people: each player organizes their pieces, completes lines and sends obstacles to the opponent.

The duel combines spatial reasoning, strategy and reflexes into a shared experience, with a track inspired by Naruto battles.

projetos.desafio: Facilitate the registration and evaluation of complementary activities during graduation.
projetos.descricao:
Complementary activities management system for students at the Federal University of Ceará. The student records their activities, informs the workload and attaches receipts.

Teachers or coordinators evaluate records, approve hours or request adjustments with comments. Monitoring by category helps the student understand what they have already completed and what is missing to meet the training requirements.

textos:
I'm Felipe Santos, software engineer. This village is an invitation to discover my work in a different way: exploring, discovering and choosing your own path.

At the tavern, I tell you how I got here. In the library, I share my education and experience. In the workshop, I present the projects I built. And, in the mail, the conversation can continue.

You can walk the streets or use shortcuts to get straight to what you're looking for. Come in, make yourself comfortable and explore at your own pace.

I've always liked stories in which each discovery opens up a new possibility. In software development, I encounter something similar: an idea becomes an interface, a need becomes a tool and a problem becomes an opportunity to learn.

This portfolio was born from the desire to unite code, design and the language of RPGs. The village gives shape to this mix: each building holds a part of my trajectory, and each project records a solution that came out of the paper.

Behind the ambiance, my purpose is simple: to create experiences that make sense to those who use it and have a structure that allows them to continue evolving.

My approach to technology began with a question: how does it work? I wanted to understand what was happening behind the screens of the websites, apps and games I used.

This curiosity led me to languages, algorithms and software engineering. Figuring out how the pieces connect continues to be one of the most interesting parts of my job.

Today, I transform this desire to learn into interfaces, systems and interactive experiences. Each challenge is a chance to investigate, build and improve the solution.

My journey at the Federal University of Ceará began in 2018, when I joined SISU on the Software Engineering course, on the Russas campus.

During my bachelor's degree, I studied requirements, data structures, programming and the fundamentals that support software construction. Academic projects also gave me space to experiment and work on concrete problems.

I took this base to the market and continue to expand my repertoire with practice: understanding the need, choosing an approach and improving the result with each delivery.

UFC · Full-stack development | apr. 2021 – Jan. 2022
Development of a web application for managing complementary activities, supporting students in recording activities and monitoring the hours required for graduation.

UFC Software Solutions Center · Internship in web development | May – Sep. 2021
Work in Darwin, selection and competition management module used in scholarship processes on the Russas campus, including PIBI, PAIP and PID.

TOTVS · Internship in web development | Jun. 2022 – May 2023
Development and maintenance of ERP Protheus with AdvPL, in addition to JavaScript applications with React and Node.js.

Funcap · Front-end development | Aug. 2021 – Apr. 2025
Participation in the creation of a digital showcase of public and business innovation. The first version used React and Node.js; a later stage started using PHP and Laravel.

Technologies and tools
HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Tailwind, Node.js, PHP, Laravel and AdvPL. On a daily basis, I use Git, GitHub, VS Code and REST APIs. My focus includes responsive interfaces, component organization, performance, and troubleshooting.

I like to investigate before choosing a path. Curiosity, persistence and analytical thinking help me understand problems and transform ideas into solutions.

Interactive interfaces and experiences
I have an affinity with React and building modular systems. I try to organize components so that the interface is pleasant to use and can grow without losing clarity.

Design and visual storytelling
I believe typography, colors and interaction also tell a story. This portfolio is a space to explore this relationship between presentation and functionality.

Games, RPGs and learning
Games interest me because of collaboration, strategy and the freedom to explore. Outside of them, I continue to look for new references in development, software architecture and design.

This is the village workshop: the place where ideas become solutions. Here I brought together projects from different contexts, from academic collaboration to scientific dissemination, including university management and games.

In each project, you will find the problem that motivated its construction, the main features and images of the interface. Links lead to the available code or publication.

Explore the screens and learn about the choices behind each creation.

A good journey is also made in company. If you want to talk about a project, exchange ideas about technology or learn more about my work, choose one of the channels below.

Email: felipesantosswengineer@email.com
Telephone: (88) 99837-8028
LinkedIn: Felipe Santos Rodrigues
Instagram: @felipe_santos_swengineer

Thanks for visiting. The village's doors remain open for your next discovery.

felipe: Hello! I'm Felipe Santos. Thank you very much for visiting and for taking some of your time to get to know my work. Feel free to explore the village, discover my stories and learn about the projects in each building.

If you want a break from your journey, go through the portal to discover the dungeon and its games. And when you want to talk, drop by mail or get in touch. I will enjoy getting to know you, exchanging ideas and perhaps working together.
